purpose.reader_question: Which model calls run after each review decision, and which calls can inspect the source directly?
purpose.expected_reading: The first flag triggers a single repair and a separate recheck. Either review can clear the current draft. A flag on recheck rejects it.
purpose.claim: The first flag triggers a single repair and a separate recheck. Either review can clear the current draft. A flag on recheck rejects it.
purpose.scope: An illustrative release-note workflow consistent with the simulated serial family on the main path.
permitted_inferences: Order of operations, branches and message availability shown.
prohibited_inferences: Runtime, cost, defect rate or provider ranking from graph layout.

inputs.source_reference: Section 2, equations (1) and (2) and the release-note example.
One repair and separate final review.

constructions.definition: Directed graph with an explicitly declared node set and directed adjacency.
constructions.method: TikZ graphs declares adjacency over vertices with fixed layout coordinates. The caption defines scope.
